upgrade_gap.security_status: 139.0.0 is an intermediate API-compatibility ceiling, not a claim of current upstream V8 security support
upgrade_gap.blocking_change: rusty_v8 migrated scope-consuming APIs from mutable HandleScope/CallbackScope references to PinScope/PinnedRef
upgrade_gap.scope: runtime callbacks, DOM bridge callbacks, native module callbacks, value construction, and scope ownership
upgrade_gap.next_stage: Migrate scope construction and callback signatures as one isolated runtime refactor, then run the complete native runtime/module suite before advancing beyond 139.0.0.
upgrade_gap.promotion_gate: No newer binding may ship until all scope migrations compile on Rust 1.88+, native runtime/module tests pass, supervised crash/timeout containment passes, and the embedded V8 security delta is reviewed.
